descLevels.1:
(Passive Effect)
Damage dealt by all attacks increases proportional to Speed. Also increases all allies' damage dealt by <color=#28d9ed>30%</color>.
If a <color=#28d9ed>limited Collab Hero (Earth/Ranger)</color> is on the team, decreases the caster's damage dealt by <color=#28d9ed>150%</color> and inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Silenced</color> on the caster for <color=#28d9ed>2 turns</color> at the start of battle. (Irremovable / Ignores Immunity and Resilience)

(Triggered Effect)
After using <color=#28d9ed>Delta Wave!</color>, activates <color=#28d9ed>Freeze!</color> on the enemy with the highest Speed, then increases all allies' <color=#28d9ed>Speed</color> for <color=#28d9ed>1 turn</color>.
